transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval on the gala broadcast package. We've got the three-camera setup, the festival archive reuse rights, the sponsor product display on stage, and a general caption feed in the current draft. Before I sign off, I need each of you — technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — to report your final operating requirements. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical requirement. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval, since it directly affects both the camera plan and the accessibility setup.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue before we lock this package. I received the countersigned performance license this morning, and it permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but it needs to be reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval — the archive reuse provision must be removed or we will be in breach of the license.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two critical talent requirements before we lock this package. First, I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — this is not yet reflected in the production schedule, but I have the agent's confirmation in email. Second, the headliner's rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's sponsor product display on stage provision. The sponsor display must be removed from the stage area or we will be in breach of the rider. Both of these need to be reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement before we lock this package. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. This booth assignment needs to be reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval.
